Resource Packs
Use a Java Edition resource pack (.zip) or your own Minecraft version file (.jar). Packs higher in the list win; anything a pack does not cover falls back to the next pack, then to Blockcraft's built-in art. Files stay in this browser.
For the official Minecraft look, add the version file from your own installation, for example %APPDATA%\.minecraft\versions\1.21.4\1.21.4.jar on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/minecraft/versions/1.21.4/1.21.4.jar on macOS (Cmd+Shift+G in the file picker) or ~/.minecraft/versions/1.21.4/1.21.4.jar on Linux. Run that version once in the Minecraft Launcher so the file exists.
